## Context
Change 1275 (ticket f1eb-5b53-f8bd-4f2b, "Shell-to-Python Tier 2: probe-rebar.sh
with assertion-parity review") ported the golden-path probe to
scripts/probe_rebar.py and re-pointed every consumer, but the Gerrit
Verified gate executes gerrit-verify.yaml from MAIN's workflow definition
against the patchset tree — so the change had to keep a transitional
scripts/probe-rebar.sh exec shim for main's still-shell golden-path step
to invoke (patchset 1 failed golden-path with exit 127).

Change 1275 has since merged. Verified on origin/main @ c3fb869ab5:
- .github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml:209 → `run: python scripts/probe_rebar.py </dev/null`
- .github/workflows/test.yml:128 → `run: python scripts/probe_rebar.py </dev/null`
- tests/unit/test_probe_wired_into_ci.py:45 asserts on `scripts/probe_rebar.py`
- docs/releasing.md:401,405,407 → `python scripts/probe_rebar.py`
The shim therefore has zero invoking callers; only historical prose names it.

## Plan
Delete scripts/probe-rebar.sh. Nothing else changes — this is a pure removal
with no behavioral change.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] scripts/probe-rebar.sh removed from the tree
- [x] No workflow, script, doc, or test *invokes* probe-rebar.sh. Proving command
  (must print nothing):
  `git grep -n 'probe-rebar' -- . ':!CHANGELOG.md' ':!pyproject.toml' ':!scripts/probe_rebar.py' ':!docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/runs/operator_attested_ac_corpus.jsonl'`
  The four excluded paths are known-benign historical residue, NOT invocations,
  and are deliberately out of scope:
  - CHANGELOG.md — release history, immutable by convention.
  - pyproject.toml:445 — the comment "(ticket f1eb, port of probe-rebar.sh)" is an
    accurate statement about where probe_rebar.py came from; rewriting it would
    erase provenance, not fix a reference.
  - docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/runs/operator_attested_ac_corpus.jsonl:97 —
    a FROZEN experiment corpus record of a past ticket's AC text; editing it would
    corrupt the dataset.
  - scripts/probe_rebar.py:2 — its own docstring says "port of probe-rebar.sh";
    same provenance rationale as the pyproject comment, left as-is.
- [x] [operator-attested] gerrit-verify golden-path job green on the deleting change itself
  (proves main's definition no longer needs the shim)

## File impact
- scripts/probe-rebar.sh (delete)


## Outcome
Landed as 18f08d57c0 on main via Gerrit change 1403 (merged 2026-08-05 01:44 UTC),
LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments.
AC3 evidence lives outside the repo snapshot (a CI run), hence [operator-attested]:
`golden-path (clean install)` = success in
https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/30966230013
